front_face_elements: rank in top-left and bottom-right corners
dominion icon adjacent to each rank marker
dominion name on a banner, cartouche, or frame plate
single central character or creature silhouette
art must preserve empty negative space around rank markers
export_notes: keep transparent-safe margins around corners if icons are layered later
prefer portrait compositions that read when scaled down
save filenames exactly as listed in each card entry
